test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

RELY
solution: The correct answer is '**depend**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Rely**' is '**Depend**'. • **Rely**: to trust somebody/something to work or behave well. [किसी पर भरोसा या विश्‍वास करना (किसी काम के लिए)] • *Example: Can I **rely** on you to keep a secret?* • **Depend**: be able to trust; rely on. (निर्भर; भरोसा करना ) • *Example: We can **depend** on her to deliver a quality product.* **Correct Answer:__** *Depend.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Protect**: to keep somebody/something safe; to defend somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को सुरक्षित रखना; व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की रक्षा करना) • **Ignore**: to pay no attention to somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु पर कोई ध्यान न देना, की उपेक्षा करना) • **Doubt**: to think something is unlikely or to feel uncertain (about something). (संदेह की स्थिति में होना या संदेह करना) 39:Td70, The correct answer is '**maintain**'.
